title: Tableau arity
statement: For a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet, define its tableau arity to be $S+3+k(S+1)+1$, where $S$ is the number of possible snapshots of $M$ and $k$ is its number of work tapes.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
